related.title: HTML 表單：原生驗證與提交狀態
related.titleEn: HTML forms: native validation and submission state
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：用標準CSV parser讀含逗號、換行與前導零ID，建立可追溯資料契約。 驗收紀錄必須包含通過/失敗、重現方式和剩餘限制；只對已檢查的模型範圍作結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Use a CSV parser for commas,newlines and leading-zero IDs with a traceable data contract. Acceptance includes pass/fail,reproduction instructions and remaining limits; conclusions stay within the checked model.
related.difference: 列出name、type、disabled、checked、required、value與validity；以requestSubmit路徑觀察互動式驗證。
related.differenceEn: Tabulate name, type, disabled, checked, required, value and validity; observe interactive validation through requestSubmit.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: CSV是有引用規則的紀錄格式，不能用split逗號或逐行當紀錄；型別與編碼需額外契約。 教學基準：10+20+30 = 60 amount total；第二檢核：3 = 3 logical records。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。

表單有效性、成功控制項與伺服器驗證是三個不同邊界；disabled 控制項不應被當成送出的值。
教學基準：8-2-1 = 5 controls；對照：5-1 = 4 controls。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: CSV has quoting rules and cannot be parsed by comma splitting or treating every line as a record; types/encoding need contracts. Teaching baseline: 10+20+30 = 60 amount total; second check: 3 = 3 logical records. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.

Constraint validity, successful controls and server validation are different boundaries; disabled controls must not be mistaken for submitted values.
Teaching baseline: 8-2-1 = 5 controls; comparison: 5-1 = 4 controls.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: WebVTT：字幕時間軸與可讀性檢查
related.titleEn: WebVTT: caption timing and readability checks
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：用標準CSV parser讀含逗號、換行與前導零ID，建立可追溯資料契約。 驗收紀錄必須包含通過/失敗、重現方式和剩餘限制；只對已檢查的模型範圍作結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Use a CSV parser for commas,newlines and leading-zero IDs with a traceable data contract. Acceptance includes pass/fail,reproduction instructions and remaining limits; conclusions stay within the checked model.
related.difference: 解析WEBVTT標頭與時間戳，分開保存speaker、cue文字、持續時間與每秒字數。
related.differenceEn: Parse theWEBVTT header and timestamps; retain speaker, text, duration and character rate separately.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: CSV是有引用規則的紀錄格式，不能用split逗號或逐行當紀錄；型別與編碼需額外契約。 教學基準：10+20+30 = 60 amount total；第二檢核：3 = 3 logical records。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。

字幕cue由開始、結束及文字組成；合法時間戳與可讀速度是不同檢查，重疊也不必然是語法錯誤。
教學基準：36/(4.2-1.2) = 12 characters/s；對照：28/(6.5-4.5) = 14 characters/s。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: CSV has quoting rules and cannot be parsed by comma splitting or treating every line as a record; types/encoding need contracts. Teaching baseline: 10+20+30 = 60 amount total; second check: 3 = 3 logical records. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.

Cues combine start, end and text; valid timestamps and readable rate are different checks, and overlap is not automatically a syntax error.
Teaching baseline: 36/(4.2-1.2) = 12 characters/s; comparison: 28/(6.5-4.5) = 14 characters/s.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
